science_card_focus: Author exactly one theoretical matched family for the dimensionless instability growth g=Re(lambda(0))*L_nl versus public x=Delta N0/N on the nonnegative source-supported subdomain [0,1], with fixed dimensionless a=alpha*L_nl=0.2. Standard WT closure keeps the anomalous correlator m equal to zero at every propagation distance and gives g=0. AC-KE retains m and gives g=2*sqrt(max(0,a*((2/3)*x-a))). Add standard_wt_closure_active and ac_ke_anomalous_closure_active as mutually exclusive source-anchored fixed conditions and bind one to each claim; all physical/model/NLSE conditions shared by both remain common. State theoretical/model prediction with NLSE validation, not direct fiber measurement. Anchor x definition to N=Nx+Ny and Delta N=Ny-Nx; explain [0,1] as a conservative nonnegative benchmark subdomain of |x|<=1. No extra claims.
